simple.summary: מַחֲנַק (machănaq) means choking First listed occurrence: Job 7 15.

definitions.full: H4267. machanaq מַחֲנָק noun [masculine] strangling, suffocation , as a mode of death, נַפְשִׁי מַחֲנָק וַתִּבְחַר Job 7:15 and my soul chooseth strangling (|| מָוֶת ). חַנָּתֹן see sub. חִנן
